name: SDN Updater
description: The update coordinator's page: releases go out when an administrator approves them, signed with the coordinator node's key by default or with an uploaded key that is never saved.

methods.description: Loads an uploaded Ed25519 key (PKCS#8 PEM or a 64-hex seed) into this instance's memory. Returns its key id and public key.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The uploaded key file, as JSON. Never stored.

wildcardJustification.detail: The uploaded key file, as JSON. Never stored. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: The uploaded key file, as JSON. Never stored.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The key id and public key, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The key id and public key, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: The key id and public key, as JSON.

methods.description: Signs a release's manifest or signal with the uploaded key under its update statement domain. Returns the signed document.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The signed release document, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The signed release document, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: The signed release document, as JSON.

methods.description: Wipes the uploaded key from memory.

wildcardJustification.detail: Empty JSON request. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON.

sequentialJustification.detail: Signs one small document per call: a few milliseconds of hashing, with nothing to run in parallel.
